parent_experiment: s02-v1; original files and deployed API preserved
purpose: Feature engineering and controlled augmentation for expensive listing prices
prior_knowledge: S02 train/CV/validation results and tail diagnosis already observed. This is a development experiment, not a fresh unbiased validation study.
split: unchanged host hash split; test prohibited
base_hyperparameters: configs/s02_protocol.json candidate; no search beyond the six declared variants

augmentation.timing: only after CV split, from fit hosts only; never score/validation/test
augmentation.label_policy: retain parent's observed price exactly; no new price labels or coordinate jitter
augmentation.semantics: repeat = duplicate observation for weighting; masked = synthetic incomplete view of a real observation, not a new property

cv_selection.ranking: eligible candidate with minimum pooled real-data MAE, then name; otherwise control

validation_gate.evaluate_only: control and preselected CV winner; never switch to another candidate using validation
validation_gate.failure: retain S02 model; preserve all results without retuning

evaluation.rows: real, unaugmented, untrimmed held-out rows only
